description: The manageiq_group module supports adding, updating and deleting groups in ManageIQ.

parameters.name: belongsto_filters
parameters.description: A list of strings with a reference to the allowed host, cluster or folder.

parameters.name: belongsto_filters_merge_mode
parameters.description: In merge mode existing settings are merged with the supplied belongsto_filters. In replace mode current values are replaced with the supplied belongsto_filters. Choices: "merge" "replace" ← (default)

parameters.name: managed_filters_merge_mode
parameters.description: In merge mode existing categories are kept or updated, new categories are added. In replace mode all categories are replaced with the supplied managed_filters. Choices: "merge" "replace" ← (default)

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: The the group role name. The role_id has precedence over the role when supplied.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: absent - group should not exist, present - group should exist. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant for the group identified by the tenant name. The tenant_id has precedence over the tenant when supplied. Tenant names are case sensitive.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The tenant for the group identified by the tenant ID.

examples:
- name: Create a group in ManageIQ with the role EvmRole-user and tenant 'my_tenant'
  community.general.manageiq_group:
    description: 'MyGroup-user'
    role: 'EvmRole-user'
    tenant: 'my_tenant'
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
      validate_certs: false # only do this when you trust the network!

- name: Create a group in ManageIQ with the role EvmRole-user and tenant with tenant_id 4
  community.general.manageiq_group:
    description: 'MyGroup-user'
    role: 'EvmRole-user'
    tenant_id: 4
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
      validate_certs: false # only do this when you trust the network!

- name:
    - Create or update a group in ManageIQ with the role EvmRole-user and tenant my_tenant.
    - Apply 3 prov_max_cpu and 2 department tags to the group.
    - Limit access to a cluster for the group.
  community.general.manageiq_group:
    description: 'MyGroup-user'
    role: 'EvmRole-user'
    tenant: my_tenant
    managed_filters:
      prov_max_cpu:
        - '1'
        - '2'
        - '4'
      department:
        - defense
        - engineering
    managed_filters_merge_mode: replace
    belongsto_filters:
      - "/belongsto/ExtManagementSystem|ProviderName/EmsFolder|Datacenters/EmsFolder|dc_name/EmsFolder|host/EmsCluster|Cluster name"
    belongsto_filters_merge_mode: merge
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'
      validate_certs: false # only do this when you trust the network!

- name: Delete a group in ManageIQ
  community.general.manageiq_group:
    state: 'absent'
    description: 'MyGroup-user'
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      username: 'admin'
      password: 'smartvm'

- name: Delete a group in ManageIQ using a token
  community.general.manageiq_group:
    state: 'absent'
    description: 'MyGroup-user'
    manageiq_connection:
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      token: 'sometoken'

return_values.name: belongsto_filters
return_values.description: A list of strings with a reference to the allowed host, cluster or folder. Returned: success

return_values.name: created_on
return_values.description: Group creation date. Returned: success Sample: "2018-08-12T08:37:55+00:00"

return_values.name: group_type
return_values.description: The group type, system or user. Returned: success

return_values.name: managed_filters
return_values.description: The tag values per category. Returned: success

return_values.name: role
return_values.description: The group role name. Returned: success

return_values.name: tenant
return_values.description: The group tenant name. Returned: success

return_values.name: updated_on
return_values.description: Group update date. Returned: success Sample: "2018-08-12T08:37:55+00:00"
